cont_single_line_comment.comment: Note: these are smaller than the values given in Figure 4 from the paper see https://github.com/ulfjack/ryu/issues/119

We are using wrapping arithmetic here, which can overflow, but we get the right answer anyway by the following argument (#47511): 1. False Negative No overflow occurs unless big(5)^p > typemax(UInt64), but typemax(UInt64) > (1 << 53), so z is never divisible by big(5)^p. QED. 2. False Positive We ask ∃ m2, p s.t. big(5)^p && m2 % wrapped_pow == 0. By exhaustive checking `all(p->UInt64(5)^p > 1<<53, 28:308)`, so there does not exist any such `m2` that satiesfies our assumptions above. QED.
